identity.title: Large Canonical Payload Batch Fingerprint Correction
identity.objective: Repair only WP156 private batch fingerprint representation so an ordinary valid record whose canonical payload JSON exceeds the per-string bound remains batch-valid: replace the re-wrapped complete payload string with an explicit SHA-256 of its exact UTF-8 bytes plus exact UTF-8 byte length, while preserving canonical payload limits, record-version identity, batch hash material, duplicates, lineage, public dataclasses and vocabulary. Permanently prove the legacy wrapper contradiction, the corrected large-record path, duplicate/tamper compatibility, and an offline WP164 large-book population boundary. No network, smoke, AF1, Hermes, credentials, trading, dependencies, workflows, or merge authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP156A. The private fingerprint returns to embedding complete canonical_payload_json as one bounded string; the permanent regression oracles and additive current-truth records are removed. No product data, public-smoke, AF1, Hermes, credential, dependency, workflow, execution, trading, or capital state exists to unwind; consumed WP164A Attempt-02 evidence remains untouched outside this branch.

items.before: The complete canonical_payload_json was embedded as one string node in another bounded WP156 canonical mapping, so a valid serialized payload over 4096 characters raised PAYLOAD_STRING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED during batch validation.
items.after: The fingerprint commits canonical_payload_json_sha256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes and canonical_payload_json_byte_length while retaining all other material unchanged.
items.compatibility_requirement: canonical_json_bytes and every payload/tree/byte bound stay unchanged; record-version identity, canonical payload hash, batch hash material, duplicates, lineage, public dataclasses and vocabulary stay unchanged.

semantic_fields.reason: The exact payload bytes must remain committed without reinterpreting their serialized representation as one semantic payload string.

items.required_rule: commit the exact UTF-8 canonical payload bytes through canonical_payload_json_sha256 and canonical_payload_json_byte_length; never embed the complete serialized payload as a string node
items.validation_rule: same bytes yield same projection; any syntactically valid semantic payload change changes the digest or length and fails committed-record validation
